results.title: Ecuador World Cup 2026 Guide: Squad, Key Players & Group E Preview | Fanorate
highlights:
026 Expectations
[...]
Ecuador are realistic contenders to advance from Group E, likely in a straight fight with Ivory Coast for second place behind Germany. Their qualifying form suggests they are arguably underrated as the 23rd-ranked side; on quality, they may be the second-best team in the group.
[...]
The expectation is to reach the knockout rounds, and given their defensive solidity, a run to the round of 16 or beyond is well within reach. With the expanded format, Ecuador have a strong platform to make their deepest World Cup run since 2006. Anything short of the knockouts would be a disappointment for a side this well-organized.
